environment.description: ECS Fargate service running in us-east-1 VPC with public-facing Application Load Balancer. ALB target group forwards HTTP traffic directly to container port 8080. Security group allows inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. ALB performs TLS termination with ACM certificate but no client authentication. Container runs as root with default Fargate platform version 1.4.0. No health check validation on response content. ECS task restart policy set to ENABLED with 3 retries.
